wasmLinkerPort.benchmark: Frozen LLVM-reactor inputs, five uninstrumented paired runs: previous Tower median 0.53 s; optimized Tower 0.42 s; SDK34 LLD 0.44 s. About 21% faster than previous Tower and 5% faster than LLD on this workload, with identical output. Callgrind executed instructions fall 27.1%, 3.173B to 2.315B. Cached indexes add about 6 MiB; optimized RSS about 343 MiB versus LLD 368 MiB. No universal platform/workload speed claim.
wasmLinkerPort.sharedMemoryBenchmark: Frozen LLVM reactor, three previous/current pairs: medians 0.43/0.44 s; RSS approximately 351640 KiB; output byte-identical. No speedup claim.
wasmLinkerPort.tlsValidation: Eight real Wasm instances check alignment, padding, repeated initialization, region isolation, GOT updates and TLS-to-TLS pointers. Common offset/GOT profile also passes SDK34 LLD; its static shared pointer-fixup behavior differs, so the full pointer case is additional Tower coverage, not a differential pass.
wasmLinkerPort.parallelBenchmark: Frozen LLVM-reactor image is byte-identical at 1/2/4/8 lanes and to the previous Tower binary. Five-run medians 0.45/0.51/0.44/0.47 seconds with scheduling noise; no parallel speedup claim. Default remains one lane, with explicit --threads=N and cost grain. Peak RSS grows about 2 MiB at multiple lanes.
